lines.translation: The Ganges, the Jamunaa where Krishna played, Kaydar Naat'h,
Benares, Kanchivaram, Puri, Dwaarkaa,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: ga(n)gaa saagar benee sa(n)gam athasath a(n)k samaaee he ||9||
lines.translation: Ganga Saagar where the Ganges empties into the ocean, Trivaynee where the three rivers come together, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, are all merged in the Lord's Being. ||9||
He Himself is the Siddha, the seeker, in meditative contemplation.
He Himself is the King and the Council.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਅਦਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: takhat bahai adalee prabh aape bharam bhed bhau jaaee he ||10||
lines.translation: God Himself, the wise Judge, sits on the throne; He takes away doubt, duality and fear. ||10||
He Himself is the Qazi; He Himself is the Mullah.
He Himself is infallible; He never makes mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape mihar daiaapat daataa naa kisai ko bairaaee he ||11||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Giver of Grace, compassion and honor; He is no one's enemy. ||11||
Whoever He forgives, He blesses with glorious greatness.
He is the Giver of all; He does not have even an iota of greed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: bharapur dhaar rahiaa nihakeval gupat pragat sabh thaaee he ||12||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord is all pervading, permeating everywhere, both hidden and manifest. ||12||
How can I praise the inaccessible, infinite Lord?
The True Creator Lord is the Enemy of ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar kare tis mele mel milai melaaee he ||13||
lines.translation: He unites those whom He blesses with His Grace; uniting them in His Union, they are united. ||13||
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva stand at His Door;
they serve the unseen, infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: hor ketee dar deesai bilalaadee mai ganat na aavai kaaee he ||14||
lines.translation: Millions of others can be seen crying at His door; I cannot even estimate their numbers. ||14||
True is the Kirtan of His Praise, and True is the Word of His Bani.
I can see no other in the Vedas and the Puraanas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: poo(n)jee saach sache gun gaavaa mai dhar hor na kaaee he ||15||
lines.translation: Truth is my capital; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. I have no other support at all. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug saachaa hai bhee hosee ||
lines.translation: In each and every age, the True Lord is, and shall always be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮਰਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun na mooaa kaun na marasee ||
lines.translation: Who has not died? Who shall not die?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak neech kahai bena(n)tee dar dekhahu liv laaee he ||16||2||
lines.translation: Nanak the lowly offers this prayer; see Him within your own self, and lovingly focus on the Lord. ||16||2||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
In duality and evil-mindedness, the soul-bride is blind and deaf.
She wears the dress of sexual desire and anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਛੋਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ghar var sahaj na jaanai chhohar bin pir need na paaee he ||1||
lines.translation: Her Husband Lord is within the home of her own heart, but she does not know Him; without her Husband Lord, she cannot go to sleep. ||1||
The great fire of desire blazes within her.
The self-willed manmukh looks around in the four directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve kiu sukh paaeeai saache haath vadaaee he ||2||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, how can she find peace? Glorious greatness rests in the hands of the True Lord. ||2||
Eradicating sexual desire, anger and egotism,
she destroys the five thieves through the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: giaan khaRag lai man siu loojhai manasaa manahi samaaee he ||3||
lines.translation: Taking up the sword of spiritual wisdom, she struggles with her mind, and hope and desire are smoothed over in her mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਦੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maa kee rakat pitaa bid dhaaraa ||
lines.translation: From the union of the mother's egg and the father's sperm,
the form of infinite beauty has been created.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jot daat jetee sabh teree too karataa sabh thaaee he ||4||
lines.translation: The blessings of light all come from You; You are the Creator Lord, pervading everywhere. ||4||
You have created birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te samajh paRee kiaa daranaa ||
lines.translation: Why should anyone fear, if they come to understand through the Guru?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: too daiaal daiaa kar dekhahi dukh darad sareerahu jaaee he ||5||
lines.translation: When You, O Merciful Lord, look with Your kindness, then pain and suffering leave the body. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਉ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar bais rahe bhau khaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who sits in the home of his own self, eats his own fears.
He quiets and holds his wandering mind still.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਹਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kamal bigaas hare sar subhar aatam raam sakhaaee he ||6||
lines.translation: His heart-lotus blossoms forth in the overflowing green pool, and the Lord of his soul becomes his companion and helper. ||6||
With their death already ordained, mortals come into this world.
How can they remain here? They have to go to the world beyond.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa amar sache amaraa pur so sach milai vadaaee he ||7||
lines.translation: True is the Lord's Command; the true ones dwell in the eternal city. The True Lord blesses them with glorious greatness. ||7||
He Himself created the whole world.
The One who made it, assigns the tasks to it.
